goal.statement: Build a one-page, phone-friendly website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, where visitors see the menu with prices, the opening hours and the shop address, and can pre-order a coffee for pickup without paying online.
goal.audience: Coffee lovers and office staff near the shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru
standards: Works on phones and on desktop
No payment taken on the site
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
rules: Show only facts given by the Requester, copied exactly
Show the written address only, no embedded map
Pre-orders are sent by email to hello@brewlab.example
No payment on the site; customers pay at pickup
done_when: The page shows the name Brew Lab and the address 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 as text, with no embedded map
The page shows the menu with all seven items and their prices: Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140, Banana bread slice 120
The page shows the opening hours: Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm, Sunday 8:30 am to 6:00 pm, with no closed days
The page shows the phone +91 98450 12345 and the email hello@brewlab.example
The page has a pre-order form with the fields name, phone, items and pickup time, and it sends the order to hello@brewlab.example
The page states that there is no online payment and customers pay at pickup, and has no payment field
The site is a single page that works on phones: no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and no broken in-page link
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.

results.criterion: The page shows the name Brew Lab and the address 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 as text, with no embedded map
results.note: #shop-address has 'Brew Lab' and '12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038' in an address element; no iframe or map; external_resources is empty.

results.criterion: The page shows the menu with all seven items and their prices: Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140, Banana bread slice 120
results.note: #menu has seven .menu-item li elements, and all seven item-and-price strings match the charter exactly.

results.criterion: The page shows the opening hours: Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm, Sunday 8:30 am to 6:00 pm, with no closed days
results.note: #opening-hours has 'Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm', 'Sunday 8:30 am to 6:00 pm' and 'No closed days'.

results.criterion: The page shows the phone +91 98450 12345 and the email hello@brewlab.example
results.note: #shop-address shows '+91 98450 12345' and a mailto link with text hello@brewlab.example.

results.criterion: The page has a pre-order form with the fields name, phone, items and pickup time, and it sends the order to hello@brewlab.example
results.note: #pre-order-form action is mailto:hello@brewlab.example, with #po-name, #po-phone, #po-items, #po-time and a submit button; the code submit test passed and an empty submit shows #po-error. It opens the visitor's email app, so receipt cannot be confirmed.

results.criterion: The page states that there is no online payment and customers pay at pickup, and has no payment field
results.note: #no-payment-note reads 'No payment, customers pay at pickup. Nothing is charged on this site.' The form has four fields and no payment input.

results.criterion: The site is a single page that works on phones: no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and no broken in-page link
results.note: Mechanical check: overflow_px 0 at 360 and 1280, broken_in_page_links empty, one HTML file, N4 met.

results.criterion: The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
results.note: Mechanical check: js_errors empty, overflow 0 at both widths, all 5 in-page links resolve (N2, N3, N4 met).

extra_issues.criterion: Necessary condition N5: every charter fact appears (missing '30 pre-orders per week')
extra_issues.note: Code reports missing: ['30 pre-orders per week']. It is the success metric and appears in no done-when item. Putting an internal target on a public page would not help visitors.

extra_issues.criterion: LLD S2 consistency with the built form
extra_issues.note: LLD comparison: S2 mismatch (coffee-item is a text area, spec says select; no quantity field). The charter and the Requester's answer say four fields, so the page follows the charter.

rubric.criterion: Consistent styling: the whole page follows the style guide (same fonts, colours, button and card styles)
rubric.note: Screenshot shows the same brown palette, Georgia headings and card and button styles at both widths; fonts measured: system-ui, Georgia.

rubric.criterion: Readable contrast: text is easy to read against its background (WCAG AA)
rubric.note: Contrast: 39 elements checked, 0 low at phone and desktop.

rubric.criterion: Clear hierarchy: one main heading, headings in order, the most important things stand out
rubric.note: One h1 and 0 skipped heading levels at both widths; the screenshot shows the title dominant.

rubric.criterion: One obvious main action: a visitor can tell at once what to do next
rubric.note: First-screen actions: only 'Pre-order for pickup', shown as a prominent button in the screenshot.

rubric.criterion: Easy navigation: a visitor can reach every section quickly, on a phone too
rubric.note: One nav with 5 in-page links reaching all 4 sections; the nav is visible on the 360px screenshot.

rubric.criterion: Tap targets are big enough on phones (at least 44x44px)
rubric.note: Small tap targets: 0 under 44px on phone.
0 images on the page, so none lack alt text.
